ovnnb_db.description: OVSDB connection string for the OVN Northbound Database.

ovnsb_db.description: OVSDB connection string for the OVN Southbound Database.

ic_nb_db.description: OVSDB connection string for the OVN Interconnection Northbound Database.

ic_sb_db.description: OVSDB connection string for the OVN Interconnection Southbound Database.

pidfile.description: Path to the PID file. If empty, no PID file is created.

detach.description: Run the daemon in the background (detach).

overwrite_pidfile.description: Overwrite an existing locked PID file.

no_chdir.description: Do not change the working directory to root when detaching.

monitor.description: Start a monitor process to restart the daemon on fatal signals.

user_group.description: Run as specified user:group. Empty string means no user switching.

unixctl.description: Path to the control socket for runtime management commands.

log_spec.description: Verbose log specification (e.g., 'dbg', 'emissary:console:dbg'). Empty string uses defaults.

log_file.description: Path to the log file. Empty string disables file logging.

syslog_target.description: UDP host:port for syslog messages. Empty string disables this.

syslog_method.description: Method for syslog: libc, unix:file, udp:ip:port, or null.

private_key.description: Path to the private key PEM file for SSL/TLS. Empty string disables PKI.

certificate.description: Path to the certificate PEM file for SSL/TLS. Empty string disables PKI.

ca_cert.description: Path to the CA certificate PEM file or 'none'. Empty string implies default CA verification.
